## 2. Brand Ethos & Design Philosophy
Tree Hues Bharat Pvt. Ltd. was founded with the singular vision of creating spaces that feel "rooted yet progressive". By bridging traditional Indian artisanal craft (hand-planed solid teak, wire-cut brickwork, carved limestone, and hand-finished bronze hardware) with contemporary European precision engineering (CNC micro-machining, German Blum hardware, concealed acoustic decoupling, and Dolby Atmos audio calibration), Tree Hues crafts bespoke residential and commercial environments that endure aesthetically and functionally.

## 3. Core Architectural & Interior Services

### 3.1 Turnkey Luxury Residential Interiors
- **Scope**: Complete interior architecture from bare-shell / warm-shell handover to turnkey styling.
- **Key Offerings**:
  - Spatial planning and structural layout optimization.
  - Custom ceiling design, architectural lighting layouts, and home automation integration.
  - Bespoke wardrobes with tinted glass, sensor-activated LED channels, and German sliding systems.
  - Master bedroom suites featuring soundproof padded acoustic fabric walls and fluted timber accents.
  - Modular kitchen systems utilizing water-resistant marine ply, acrylic/PU finishes, and imported quartz worktops.

### 3.2 Progressive Architecture & Civil Execution
- **Scope**: Ground-up villa construction, structural alteration, and exterior landscaping.
- **Key Offerings**:
  - Reinforced concrete framing, board-formed architectural concrete, and exposed wire-cut brick facades.
  - Seamless transitional courtyards, reflection pools, and internal skylight lightwells.
  - High-performance double-glazed fenestration, thermally insulated slimline aluminum windows.
  - Structural civil retrofitting and load-bearing redistribution for expansive open-plan living.

### 3.3 Precision Timber Joinery & Modular Systems
- **Scope**: Factory-fabricated architectural woodwork and custom loose furniture.
- **Key Offerings**:
  - Fluted walnut, smoked oak, and natural Burma teak wall paneling with integrated shadow reveals.
  - Concealed pocket doors, magnetic jamb-less architectural doors, and pivot entrance doors.
  - CNC-machined acoustic slats backed by recycled PET sound absorption felt.
  - Custom dining tables in solid European oak with hand-patinated brass legs.

### 3.4 Private Dolby Atmos Cinema & Acoustic Engineering
- **Scope**: Dedicated private home cinemas, screening rooms, and multi-channel media lounges.
- **Key Offerings**:
  - Calibrated 9.4.4 and 7.2.4 Dolby Atmos surround configurations.
  - Triad / Bowers & Wilkins concealed in-wall architectural speakers and balanced dual/quad subwoofers.
  - Custom room-within-a-room acoustic decoupling (whisper clips, resilient channels, mass-loaded vinyl).
  - Acoustically transparent micro-woven 4K projection screens.
  - Starlight fiber-optic acoustic ceiling panels and motorized dual-motor leather cinema recliners.

## 4. Flagship Projects Portfolio

### Project 1: Vajram Tiara Luxury Duplex
- **Location**: Hebbal, North Bangalore
- **Type**: Luxury Duplex Penthouse (4,800 sq.ft)
- **Timeline**: 7 Months Turnkey Execution
- **Key Features**: Double-height living salon with 22-foot fluted American walnut wall paneling, brushed brass reveals, Italian Statuario marble flooring, custom bar credenza, and minimalist open dining.

### Project 2: Araku Coffee Flagship Experience Centre
- **Location**: 12th Main Road, Indiranagar, Bangalore
- **Type**: Commercial Flagship & Roastery (3,500 sq.ft)
- **Timeline**: 4.5 Months Turnkey Execution
- **Key Features**: Custom curved fluted timber brew bar, terracotta tile walling, raw exposed steel framing, custom cupping room with suspended acoustic baffle canopies.

### Project 3: Total Environment Windmills of Your Mind Villa 64
- **Location**: Whitefield, Bangalore
- **Type**: Independent Luxury Villa (5,900 sq.ft)
- **Timeline**: 9 Months Comprehensive Renovation & Joinery
- **Key Features**: Board-formed exposed concrete, wire-cut exposed brickwork, handcrafted Burma teakwood joinery, automated sliding glass curtains opening into private deck and water court.

### Project 4: Total Environment After The Rain Home Cinema Sanctuary
- **Location**: Yelahanka, North Bangalore
- **Type**: Dedicated 9.4.4 Private Dolby Atmos Cinema (450 sq.ft)
- **Timeline**: 8 Weeks Precision Execution
- **Key Features**: High-density micro-perforated acoustic timber wall paneling (NRC 0.85), motorized tiered leather recliners, custom starlight ceiling, Stewart Filmscreen acoustically transparent screen, and Triad concealed audio.

### Project 5: V2 Poorvi Enclave Penthouse
- **Location**: Whitefield, Bangalore
- **Type**: Modern Contemporary Penthouse (3,800 sq.ft)
- **Timeline**: 6 Months Turnkey Execution
- **Key Features**: Open-concept great room, floor-to-ceiling smoked glass dividers, German Blum-fitted modular island kitchen, and acoustic fluting in the master suite.

### Project 6: Mirabilis Residence
- **Location**: Kadugodi, Whitefield, Bangalore
- **Type**: Warm Minimalist Urban Duplex (3,200 sq.ft)
- **Timeline**: 5 Months Turnkey Execution
- **Key Features**: White oak cabinetry, integrated LED cove illumination, concealed storage walls, and custom floating study console.
